title: Unit 3 第三课时 基础达标与综合拓展

sections.title: 一、语音题
sections.instruction: 根据语音知识，从每小题所给的选项中选出正确的一项。

questions.prompt: 1. 下列单词中画线字母“a”发音为 /æ/ 的是 ( )
questions.translation: 下列单词中画线字母“a”发音为 /æ/ 的是：magic。
questions.explanation: magic中的字母a在闭音节中发短元音 /æ/；patient中的字母a发双元音 /eɪ/；task中的字母a发长元音 /ɑː/。故选 m<u>a</u>gic。

questions.prompt: 2. 下列单词中字母“i”发音为 /ɪ/ 的是 ( )
questions.translation: 下列单词中字母“i”发音为 /ɪ/ 的是：strict。
questions.explanation: strict中的字母i在闭音节中发短元音 /ɪ/；hide和wild中的字母i均发双元音 /aɪ/。故选 str<u>i</u>ct。

questions.prompt: 3. 下列单词中画线字母“u”发音为 /ʊ/ 的是 ( )
questions.translation: 下列单词中画线字母“u”发音为 /ʊ/ 的是：pull。
questions.explanation: pull中的字母u发短元音 /ʊ/；rush和hug中的字母u均发短元音 /ʌ/。故选 p<u>u</u>ll。

questions.prompt: 4. 下列单词中字母组合发音为 /ɜː/ 的是 ( )
questions.translation: 下列单词中字母组合发音为 /ɜː/ 的是：serve。
questions.explanation: serve中的er在重读音节中发长元音 /ɜː/；laughter中的augh发/ɑːf/；lantern中的an发/æn/。故选 s<u>er</u>ve。

questions.prompt: 5. 下列单词中重音在第二个音节的是 ( )
questions.translation: 下列单词中重音在第二个音节的是：pollution。
questions.explanation: pollution的发音为 /pəˈluːʃn/，重音在第二个音节；influence /ˈɪnfluəns/ 和 memory /ˈmeməri/ 的重音均在第一个音节。故选 pollution。

questions.prompt: 6. 下列单词中画线字母“e”发音为 /e/ 的是 ( )
questions.translation: 下列单词中画线字母“e”发音为 /e/ 的是：welcome/sentence。
questions.explanation: sentence中的第一个e发短元音 /e/；welcome中的e发 /e/；event中的首字母e发 /ɪ/。根据参考答案选 sentence。故选 s<u>e</u>ntence。

questions.prompt: 7. 下列单词中画线字母“a”发音不为 /æ/ 的是 ( )
questions.translation: 下列单词中画线字母“a”发音不为 /æ/ 的是：eraser。
questions.explanation: eraser中的a在相对开音节中发双元音 /eɪ/；而plan和fact中的a均发短元音 /æ/。故选 er<u>a</u>ser。

questions.prompt: 8. 下列单词中画线字母“a”共有 ______ 种发音：f<u>a</u>ce, t<u>a</u>sk, cl<u>a</u>ss
questions.translation: face, task, class 中画线字母“a”共有 2 种发音。
questions.explanation: face中的a发双元音 /eɪ/；task和class中的a均发长元音 /ɑː/。因此共有 /eɪ/ 和 /ɑː/ 2种发音。故选 2。

sections.title: 二、根据句意或汉语提示写单词
sections.instruction: 根据汉语提示与句意，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项。

questions.prompt: 1. Here are some books and pens in this ______ (书架).
questions.translation: 这个书架里有一些书和钢笔。
questions.explanation: 名词bookcase意为“书架，书柜”。故选 bookcase。

questions.prompt: 2. Many parents worry that too much ______ (屏幕) time will be bad for their children's health.
questions.translation: 许多父母担心过多的屏幕时间会对孩子的健康有害。
questions.explanation: screen time为常用搭配，意为“屏幕时间”。名词screen意为“屏幕”。故选 screen。

questions.prompt: 3. There is a ______ (现代的) cinema in the northern part of town.
questions.translation: 在城镇北部有一家现代化的电影院。
questions.explanation: 形容词modern意为“现代的，当代的”。故选 modern。

questions.prompt: 4. I think it's so exciting to see the ______ (raise) of the national flag.
questions.translation: 我认为看升国旗是如此令人激动。
questions.explanation: 定冠词the后接名词形式，动词raise加-ing构成动名词/名词raising（升起，举起）。故选 raising。

questions.prompt: 5. Linda offered to give her ______ to the old man on the bus.
questions.translation: 琳达在公交车上主动给老人让座。
questions.explanation: give one's seat to sb. 为固定搭配，意为“给某人让座”。故选 seat。

questions.prompt: 6. Lucy and Lily are twin sisters. They are so ______ that it's almost impossible to tell one from the other.
questions.translation: 露西和莉莉是双胞胎姐妹。她们长得如此相似以至于几乎无法分辨彼此。
questions.explanation: 形容词similar意为“相似的”。be so similar that... 意为“如此相似以至于……”。故选 similar。

questions.prompt: 7. ______ (声音) travels more slowly than light.
questions.translation: 声音传播的速度比光慢。
questions.explanation: 自然界中的声音用名词sound。句首首字母大写为Sound。故选 Sound。

questions.prompt: 8. Bill's sister has a very beautiful ______. She can sing very well.
questions.translation: 比尔的妹妹有非常优美的嗓音。她歌唱得很好。
questions.explanation: 人的嗓音、说话声或歌声用名词voice。故选 voice。

sections.title: 三、用所给词的适当形式填空
sections.instruction: 根据句子语法与句意，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出正确的一项。

questions.prompt: 1. The ______ (screen) tells us arrival and departure time of our flight.
questions.translation: 屏幕告诉我们航班的到达和起飞时间。
questions.explanation: 根据谓语动词tells为三单形式，主语名词screen用单数形式。故选 screen。

questions.prompt: 2. The ______ news made the family and their neighbours ______ (amaze).
questions.translation: 这个令人惊叹的消息让这家人和他们的邻居们感到非常震惊。
questions.explanation: 第一空修饰物news用amazing（令人惊异的）；第二空作宾补表示人感到震惊用amazed（感到惊奇的）。故选 amazing; amazed。

questions.prompt: 3. Students want ______ (raise) money for a Hope School.
questions.translation: 学生们想为希望小学筹集资金。
questions.explanation: want to do sth. 为固定句型，后接动词不定式to raise。故选 to raise。

questions.prompt: 4. ______ (change) a new way and you can get it.
questions.translation: 换一种新方法，你就能做到了。
questions.explanation: “祈使句 + and + 简单句”结构中，祈使句以动词原形开头，首字母大写为Change。故选 Change。

questions.prompt: 5. Do you enjoy reading in ______ (you) free time?
questions.translation: 你在空闲时间喜欢看书吗？
questions.explanation: 修饰名词短语free time应用形容词性物主代词your（你的）。故选 your。

questions.prompt: 6. How about ______ (take) a walk after dinner?
questions.translation: 晚饭后去散步怎么样？
questions.explanation: How about doing sth. 为固定句型，介词about后接动名词taking。故选 taking。

questions.prompt: 7. The river ______ (rise) after the heavy rain every summer.
questions.translation: 每年夏天大雨之后河水都会上涨。
questions.explanation: 根据every summer可知用一般现在时，主语The river为第三人称单数，动词rise需变为三单形式rises。故选 rises。

questions.prompt: 8. How many ______ (student) are there in your school?
questions.translation: 你们学校有多少名学生？
questions.explanation: how many修饰可数名词复数students。故选 students。

questions.prompt: 9. It is usually ______ (rain) this summer in Shenyang.
questions.translation: 今年夏天沈阳通常多雨。
questions.explanation: be动词is后接形容词rainy（多雨的，阴雨的）作表语。故选 rainy。

questions.prompt: 10. His father works as a ______ (drive).
questions.translation: 他的父亲做司机工作。
questions.explanation: as a后接表示职业的名词driver（司机）。故选 driver。

questions.prompt: 11. Our classroom is on the ______ (one) floor.
questions.translation: 我们的教室在一楼。
questions.explanation: 表示楼层用序数词，one对应的序数词为first，on the first floor意为“在一楼”。故选 first。

questions.prompt: 12. Li Hua is very ______ (friend) to others.
questions.translation: 李华对别人非常友善。
questions.explanation: be friendly to sb. 为固定搭配，形容词friendly作表语，意为“友好的”。故选 friendly。

questions.prompt: 13. He wants ______ (go) shopping with me after school.
questions.translation: 放学后他想和我一起去购物。
questions.explanation: want to do sth. 为固定搭配，后接动词不定式to go。故选 to go。

questions.prompt: 14. Anna is a nice and ______ (help) girl.
questions.translation: 安娜是一个善良且乐于助人的女孩。
questions.explanation: 与nice并列修饰名词girl，应用形容词helpful（乐于助人的）。故选 helpful。

questions.prompt: 15. The sun is shining ______ (bright) on the beautiful day.
questions.translation: 在这个美好的一天，阳光明媚地照耀着。
questions.explanation: 修饰现在分词shining应用副词brightly（明亮地，灿烂地）。故选 brightly。

sections.title: 四、句型转换
sections.instruction: 按要求完成下列句子变换，从每小题所给的选项中选出正确的一项。

questions.prompt:
1. Where is the bookcase? (变复数)
Where ______ the ______?
questions.translation: 书架在哪里？（变复数）
questions.explanation: 主语改为复数bookcases，be动词is变为are。故选 are the bookcases。

questions.prompt:
2. Is there a whiteboard in your classroom? (作肯定回答)
______, ______ ______.
questions.translation: 你们教室里有一块白板吗？（作肯定回答）
questions.explanation: Is there...的肯定简略回答为“Yes, there is.”。故选 Yes, there is.。

questions.prompt:
3. Are there any lockers? (作否定回答)
______, ______ ______.
questions.translation: 有储物柜吗？（作否定回答）
questions.explanation: Are there...的否定简略回答为“No, there aren't.”。故选 No, there aren't.。

questions.prompt:
4. The library is behind the classroom building. (对画线部分 behind the classroom building 提问)
______ is the library?
questions.translation: 图书馆在哪里？
questions.explanation: 对地点介词短语behind the classroom building提问，疑问词用Where。句首首字母大写。故选 Where。

questions.prompt:
5. Some trees are in front of the sports field. (改为 there be 句型)
______ ______ some trees in front of the sports field.
questions.translation: 运动场前面有一些树。
questions.explanation: 改为there be句型，主语some trees为复数，用There are。故选 There are。

questions.prompt:
6. How about going out for dinner with Bill? (改为同义句)
______ ______ going out for dinner with Bill?
questions.translation: 和比尔一起出去吃晚饭怎么样？
questions.explanation: How about doing sth. 的同义句型为 What about doing sth.。故选 What about。

sections.title: 五、用方框中系动词的适当形式完成句子
sections.instruction: 从方框中选择恰当的系动词并用其正确形式填空，每词限用一次。

questions.prompt: 1. This paper ______ like silk and its price is high.
questions.translation: 这种纸摸起来像丝绸一样，而且价格很高。
questions.explanation: 主语This paper为第三人称单数，表示触觉“摸起来像”用feels like。故选 feel。

questions.prompt: 2. Are you OK? Your voice ______ different from usual.
questions.translation: 你还好吗？你的声音听起来和平常不太一样。
questions.explanation: 主语Your voice为第三人称单数，表示听觉“听起来”用sounds。故选 sound。

questions.prompt: 3. There's a lot of rubbish in this corner and it ______ terrible.
questions.translation: 这个角落里有很多垃圾，闻起来很糟糕。
questions.explanation: 主语it为第三人称单数，表示嗅觉“闻起来”用smells。故选 smell。

questions.prompt: 4. I think Annie ______ better in the white T-shirt than in the blue one.
questions.translation: 我认为安妮穿白色T恤比穿蓝色T恤看起来更好看。
questions.explanation: 主语Annie为第三人称单数，表示视觉“看起来”用looks。故选 look。

questions.prompt: 5. Although the Moutai-flavored latte was popular, some customers thought it ______ strange after drinking it.
questions.translation: 虽然茅台味拿铁咖啡很受欢迎，但一些顾客在喝过之后觉得它尝起来很奇怪。
questions.explanation: 根据主句thought可知句子为一般过去时，表示味觉“尝起来”用tasted。故选 taste。

sections.title: 六、阅读理解
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从每小题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Today at school, I get into an argument (争吵) with a boy in my class.

I think that I am right and he is wrong, but he thinks that I am wrong and he is right. The teacher wants to teach us a lesson.

She brings us up to the front of the class and places him on one side of her desk and me on the other side. There is a large, round object (物体) on her desk. It is black. But when she asks the boy the colour of the object, he answers, "White."

"White? How can it be?" I say to the boy. Another argument starts. The teacher tells us to change our places. Then she asks me, "What colour is the object?"

I have to answer, "White." It was an object with two differently coloured sides. From his side it is white. From my side it is black.

Sometimes we need to stand in the other person's shoes and look at the problem through his or her eyes.

questions.prompt: 1. How does the writer feel when the boy says the object is white?
questions.translation: 当那个男孩说物体是白色的时候，作者感觉如何？
questions.explanation: 根据文中“'White? How can it be?' I say to the boy.”可知作者对此感到非常震惊/惊讶（Surprised）。故选 Surprised.。

questions.prompt: 2. Which of the following can be put in "[*LAYOUT: Question placeholder 2*]" in Paragraph 4?
options: Do you think he is right?
What do you think of the object?
questions.translation: 第四段中的占位处应填入下列哪一项？
questions.explanation: 根据后一句作者回答“White.”可知，老师调换位置后再次询问物体的颜色“What colour is the object?”。故选 What colour is the object?。

questions.prompt: 3. Why does the object look so different in colour?
options: Because the boy and the writer have no ideas about colours.
Because the object has two different colours on the two sides.
Because the boy and the writer like making arguments with each other.
Because the teacher is angry and she wants to play tricks on the students.
questions.translation: 为什么这个物体看起来颜色如此不同？
questions.explanation: 根据第五段中的“It was an object with two differently coloured sides.”可知，因为物体的两面颜色不同。故选 Because the object has two different colours on the two sides.。

questions.prompt: 4. What can we learn from the story?
options: We must believe what we see and speak out.
Teachers are always cleverer than their students.
Sometimes we need to look at a problem in others' shoes.
Never have an argument with others in front of teachers.
questions.translation: 我们可以从这个故事中学到什么？
questions.explanation: 根据最后一段“Sometimes we need to stand in the other person's shoes and look at the problem through his or her eyes.”可知，有时我们需要站在他人的角度看问题。故选 Sometimes we need to look at a problem in others' shoes.。

sections.title: 七、还原句子
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从所给的选项中选出可以填入空白处的最佳选项，其中有一个多余选项。
sections.passage:
Dave loves to read. [1] His classmates make fun of him and think he is bookish, but his parents and his teachers think he's great. They say reading is important, and it can help a lot.

One day, Dave was reading a book about planes. [2] The next day, Dave's science teacher asked her students to do a project (项目) about planes in five days. Who did everyone want in their group? Of course, Dave!

At last, Dave, Linda, Sam and Joe were in one group. [3] They also went to the library to look for more books about planes. Then the group met at Joe's house and decided to make a model plane. Dave had many good ideas. [4] The model plane looked great. The four students were very happy because of their work. When they gave the plane to their science teacher, she said, "How beautiful!" She gave them an A+.
wordbank: With Dave's help, it took them only one day to make the model plane.
He told his classmates about his reading.
He reads in all of his free time.
Dave's parents were strict with him.
They first read Dave's book about planes.

questions.translation: 他把所有的空闲时间都花在阅读上。
questions.explanation: 前句“Dave loves to read.”说明Dave爱读书，选项C“He reads in all of his free time”进一步具体说明他在所有空闲时间都看书。故选 C。

questions.translation: 他把他的阅读内容告诉了同学们。
questions.explanation: 前句提到读关于飞机的书，后文提到第二天科学老师布置飞机项目时大家都要找Dave一组，说明Dave之前和同学们分享过读书收获（选项B）。故选 B。

questions.translation: 他们首先阅读了戴夫关于飞机的书。
questions.explanation: 后句紧接着“They also went to the library...”，由also可知前一句是“They first read Dave's book about planes”（选项E）。故选 E。

questions.translation: 在戴夫的帮助下，他们只花了一天时间就做好了模型飞机。
questions.explanation: 前句提到“Dave had many good ideas”，后句写模型飞机看起来棒极了，选项A“With Dave's help, it took them only one day...”自然承接。故选 A。

sections.title: 八、语篇填空
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项填入空白处，使短文通顺完整。
sections.passage:
What is a market like? Usually there are many people and it [1] (smell) bad. But the markets in Shanghai Hongkou District are different.

In 2023, a library in Shanghai Hongkou District gave away (捐赠) about 600 books to the workers at Fuci food market. It was the [2] (one) food market reading space (区域) in the district.

Now, 13 food markets in Hongkou District have reading spaces. There, stall owners (摊主) and other workers can take [3] break; they can read and enjoy [4] (take) part in cultural (文化的) activities.

When the children are on holiday, some parents bring their children to the market to be with [5] (they). Those children can do many things in the reading space. Some [6] really good children are reading. The stories in the book are very interesting, [7] the children really like there.

Many reading spaces have volunteers (志愿者). They [8] (usual) help the children with their homework and teach them to read. Sometimes they have some other interesting [9] (activity). Wu Shaodan, a volunteer, said, "I want to be a teacher in the future. Spending the time with the children helps me get some teaching experience. I am [10] (happily) that I can help them."

questions.prompt: 1. (smell) ( )
questions.translation: 通常有很多人，而且闻起来很糟糕。
questions.explanation: 主语it为第三人称单数，一般现在时谓语动词smell用三单形式smells。故选 smells。

questions.translation: 这是该地区第一个菜市场阅读空间。
questions.explanation: the + 序数词表示“第几个”，one对应的序数词为first。故选 first。

questions.translation: 在那里，摊主和其他工人可以休息一下。
questions.explanation: take a break为固定短语，意为“休息一下”。故选 a。

questions.prompt: 4. (take) ( )
questions.translation: 他们可以阅读并享受参与文化活动。
questions.explanation: enjoy doing sth. 为固定搭配，后接动名词taking。故选 taking。

questions.prompt: 5. (they) ( )
questions.translation: 有些父母带着孩子来市场和他们在一起。
questions.explanation: 介词with后接人称代词宾格them。故选 them。

questions.translation: 有些非常优秀的孩子在看书。
questions.explanation: 根据上下文搭配与参考答案，此处填介词at。故选 at。

questions.translation: 书中的故事非常有趣，所以孩子们真的很喜欢那里。
questions.explanation: 前后分句为因果关系，后句表示结果，用连词so。故选 so。

questions.prompt: 8. (usual) ( )
questions.translation: 他们通常帮助孩子们辅导作业，并教他们阅读。
questions.explanation: 修饰动词help应用频度副词usually（通常）。故选 usually。

questions.prompt: 9. (activity) ( )
questions.translation: 有时他们还会开展其他一些有趣的活动。
questions.explanation: some other修饰可数名词复数activities。故选 activities。

questions.prompt: 10. (happily) ( )
questions.translation: 我很开心能帮助他们。
questions.explanation: be动词am后接形容词happy作表语，be happy that... 意为“很高兴……”。故选 happy。

sections.title: 九、真题演练 (阅读理解)
sections.instruction: 阅读下列实验报告，从每小题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
| Question | What is the greenhouse effect? | | :--- | :--- | | **Materials** | Two cups, soil, two thermometers (温度计), a glass jar (罐子) | | **Place** | Outdoor area | | **Steps** | 1. Prepare two cups filled with soil, and mark A and B on the cups.
2. Stick the thermometers in Cup A and Cup B.
3. Put the two cups in the sunlight for 10 minutes and record the temperatures in the two cups in A1 and B1.
4. Place the glass jar upside down over Cup A and keep Cup B unchanged. After 10 minutes, record the temperatures in A2 and B2.
5. Compare the temperatures in Cup A and Cup B. | | **Record** | **The temperature in Step 3**
Cup A \| A1: 28 °C
Cup B \| B1: 28 °C

**The temperature in Step 4**
Cup A \| A2: 31 °C
Cup B \| B2: 29 °C | | **Findings** | A1 is the same as B1.
________?________ |

questions.prompt: 1. Which of the following materials is needed in the experiment?
questions.translation: 实验中需要下列哪种材料？
questions.explanation: 根据Materials一栏“Two cups, soil, two thermometers, a glass jar”可知需要土壤（Soil）。故选 Soil.。

questions.prompt: 2. What is the best weather for doing the experiment?
questions.translation: 做这个实验的最佳天气是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据步骤3“Put the two cups in the sunlight for 10 minutes”可知需要在阳光充足的天气进行，根据参考答案选 Sunny。故选 Sunny.。

questions.prompt: 3. Which picture can match Step 4?
options: Cup A covered by glass jar, Cup B uncovered
Cup A uncovered, Cup B covered
questions.translation: 哪幅图片能匹配步骤4？
questions.explanation: 根据步骤4“Place the glass jar upside down over Cup A and keep Cup B unchanged.”可知A杯倒扣玻璃罐，B杯保持敞开不变。根据参考答案选 Cup A covered by glass jar, Cup B uncovered。故选 Cup A covered by glass jar, Cup B uncovered。

questions.prompt: 4. Which of the following can be put in the ________?________
options: A2 is two degrees higher than B2.
A2 is three degrees lower than A1.
B2 is three degrees higher than B1.
B2 is one degree lower than A1.
questions.translation: 横线处可以填入下列哪一项？
questions.explanation: 根据Record数据，Step 4中 A2为31 °C，B2为29 °C，因此 A2 比 B2 高 2 °C（31 - 29 = 2）。故选 A2 is two degrees higher than B2.。

questions.prompt: 5. In which class may Li Hua's study group share the report?
questions.translation: 李华的学习小组可能会在哪门课上分享这份报告？
questions.explanation: 关于温室效应和环境生态的科学实验报告最适合在生物课（Biology）或科学课上分享。故选 Biology.。
